Requirement: An active compatible modular item with one empty mount.

Convergence (EC17)

ACTION • Roll 4+ • USES 1 • RESOURCE 0

Resolution: Equipment + Presence vs Harmony

Range / Targeting: 8 units / Sphere 2; every creature in the area

Effect: Each successfully affected creature takes 3 Radiant Damage.

Surge 1: Pull one successfully affected creature 1 unit toward the center of the area. Once per use.

Surge 2: Deal +1 Radiant Damage to each successfully affected creature. Once per use.

Design note: Hits allies too. Ordinary Support Augments do not reshape or select targets for this Function under D2.

Major treasure. Four rolled dice may be inaccessible to a low-Attribute user under D1.
system.flavor: A major area payoff with one Adventure-limited Use.
